messages:
maya_partnerships: Quick heads-up 1: we had overlapping claims across an SI and a marketplace referral this morning. Want to codify a simple, enforceable ROE for co-sell + marketplace leads.

sam_sales: yes please. customer clicked our GCP marketplace listing, then SI reached out and said they owned the account. messy.

jon_se: from infra side we need deterministic attribution so downstream billing and quota assignment don't race.

lina_si: SI POV: if we have introduction evidence (email thread with customer + SI contact, signed NDA, or MSA) within the last 45 days, SI is primary. marketplace should only claim when there's no SI introduction recorded.

maya_partnerships: 45 days feels long; can we make it 30? also need to handle hardware partner referrals that route through SIs.

priya_pm: proposal: primary attribution priority list we can encode and expose in CRM. include evidence_type and recency windows.

jon_se: suggested logic we can implement:
```yaml
attribution_priority:
  - si_intro: if: evidence in [email_thread, signed_ndas, mta] and days_since <= 30
  - recent_activity: if: last_activity_days <= 14 and assignee_present == true
  - partner_hw_referral: if: referral_source == hardware_partner and partner_claim == true
  - marketplace_click: if: referral_source == marketplace and no si_intro
  - sdr_inbound: default
```
This yields a single owner tag that our billing and quota systems can consume.

lina_si: fine. add an explicit rule for joint-announce credit: if SI and HW partner collaborate and customer approves, split credit 50/50 for partner comp purposes but keep one primary owner in CRM.

sam_sales: add manual override guard: only Partnerships or Sales Ops can change ownership within 72h of auto-assign. Overrides must include reason + links to evidence.

maya_partnerships: agree. let's also require an automated audit entry with the evidence_type field. ops, can we get a Slack alert when ownership flips? @triagebot

triagebot: automation checklist:
1) webhook to ingest referral_source, evidence_type, evidence_link
2) CRM rule evaluator to set lead.owner and lead.attributes.routing_rule
3) append audit entry on changes with user, time, reason
4) slack post to #partnerships and #sales when owner != previous_owner
5) allow manual override via Salesforce case tagged 'partnerships-override'

priya_pm: for joint announcements: require customer opt-in, logos cleared, one-paragraph co-announce draft and comms contact. need 10 business days for legal review.

lina_si: Partnerships should own a fillable announcement template + contact list for legal/comms. saves back-and-forth.

jon_se: telemetry: tag every lead with attributes: routing_rule, evidence_type, evidence_link, assigned_by, assigned_at. This will let us measure misroutes and SLA for overrides.

sam_sales: can we pilot with top 25 SI partner accounts for 3 weeks? measure number of claims, overrides, and time-to-owner.

maya_partnerships: good idea. action items:
- maya: draft ROE doc + announcement template and post to Confluence (EOD)
- jon: implement CRM evaluator and tags (5 biz days)
- triagebot: add slack alerts and audit logging (3 biz days)
- sam + lina: pick pilot accounts (tomorrow)
- priya: write joint-announce checklist (EOD)

triagebot: reminder created: "Pilot: SI attribution rules kickoff" Thursday 9:30 PT

maya_partnerships: thanks team. TL;DR: deterministic attribution ruleset, manual override guard with audit, co-announce template + timeline, pilot on top 25 SI accounts. I'll post a short office hours invite for Friday 11am PT to walk through the SOP.
